caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented glass bottle positioned in the center of the composition against a plain, light beige background. The bottle is amber or yellowish-brown in color and has a rounded body with vertical ribbed lines extending from the narrow neck to the widest part of the base. The neck is cylindrical, slightly flared at the opening, and the overall shape of the bottle is bulbous at the bottom and tapers smoothly upward. The ribbing creates highlights and shadows that emphasize the glass texture and three-dimensionality. In the lower right part of the image, the name "FRITZ BOEHMER" is written in capital letters. No other objects or decorative elements are present in the composition.
title: Whiskey Flask
